allows.actions: Every action asks, every session. Nothing is remembered as pre-approved.
allows.consent: Asked every time. Approval never carries over to the next session.
allows.egress: Every outbound call asks, even through a door you opened before.
allows.lan_devices: Allowed, but each reach asks you first.

bridge.costs: You will answer a lot of prompts. Good when the box is shared, when you are still learning what it does, or when you simply want to watch it work for a while.

edge.label: Nothing in front of it
edge.summary: You said there is nothing at the edge of your network. The Bridge posture you picked is the whole fence, and it is configured.

bridge.label: Moat
bridge.note: Moat fits an island build, so nothing was changed.
bridge.summary: Every outbound call and every action asks you first, every session.

contracts._note: These are contracts, not configuration. No manifest field disables them; the wizard and the loader never read this block as switches.
contracts.action_gates: On at the action boundary. Reach-into-the-world actions are gated.
contracts.consent_gate: Human-only. No agent can grant consent on a person's behalf.
contracts.telemetry: None. No phone-home; every egress is owner-invoked and enumerated.
contracts.vault: Encrypted, PIN/MFA-gated. Even the AI must ask to read it.

crew.note: On a machine this size, the crew can take up to 5 specialists on top of the master team. That number is grounded in a live run of the full agent team on measured test hardware.

interview.goal: a bot that helps a beginner learn the night sky and space with a small telescope

persona.goal: a bot that helps a beginner learn the night sky and space with a small telescope
persona.name: HomeBot
persona.note: No place of its own was made; this records what the owner said it is for. `puffpai setup --scaffold` makes one.

posture.combination: No internet during the build, but your home network is fair game afterwards - Home Assistant, a media server, local devices.

surfaces.note: Surfaces outside this list are not loaded at all - not hidden, not loaded. This is a proposal: add or remove anything before you accept it.

reasons.instruments.telescope: Telescope and sky feeds, because you asked about 'night sky' and that comes with Science and astronomy Q&A (Stack Exchange).
reasons.knowledge.library: Offline reference library, because you asked about 'night sky' and that comes with Science and astronomy Q&A (Stack Exchange).
